Lille Olympique Sporting Club, commonly referred to as LOSC, LOSC Lille or simply Lille, is a professional football club based in Lille, Northern France competing in Ligue 1, the top division of French football. Lille have played their home matches since 2012 at the Stade Pierre-Mauroy. The 50,186-capacity retractable roof venue is the fourth-largest stadium in France.
